text:
maria_marketing: quick heads up — seeing a spike where HubSpot leads are sitting in the enrichment queue and not getting assigned to Salesforce for ~5-10m. throwing off SDR SLAs. :thinking_face:

sam_ops: ugh, saw that too on the observability dashboard. looks like RR slot exhaustion during the 11:30-12:00 PST burst. metrics show RR claim attempts succeeded but no SF create webhook fired. :eyes:

kevin_salesops: is this the HS->SF mapping change from last week? i patched a property rename (source_region -> region_source). maybe mapping mismatch.

maria_marketing: i rolled that change but kept a compatibility branch. should be fallback-safe but i can revert if needed. not sure why enrichment would block the webhook though.

olivia_engineer: the pipeline is: hs webhook -> enrichment service (async) -> rr-claim -> sf-create. if enrichment times out we enqueue a retry job. looks like the retry backlog grew and the rr-claim held onto items until enrichment finished.

sarah_growth: can we short-circuit older events? SLA should be: ack in <30s, assigned in <2m, create in SF <5m. we're hitting assign >5m in ~12% of cases.

kevin_salesops: that's above our handoff SLA. any quick mitigation? prefresh?

olivia_engineer: short-term: increase enrichment worker parallelism and add a TTL that bypasses enrichment after 90s and sends minimal payload to SF (fallback property set to `enrich_skipped=true`). longer-term: fix RR fairness so claim slots don't starve when queue depth spikes.

maria_marketing: can we A/B the fallback? worried about noisy SF records if fallback hits too often.

sam_ops: agree. propose: enable fallback for the next 30m during peak window only, and log a tag `fallback_30m_test` so ops/sales can filter. will monitor drop in SLA breaches.

olivia_engineer: quick config snippet i can flip in k8s configMap if y'all 👍:
```yaml
enrichment:
  workers: 40
  timeout_seconds: 90
  fallback_to_minimal_sf_payload: true
  fallback_tag: "fallback_30m_test"
rr_claim:
  max_inflight_per_shard: 200
  fairness_window_ms: 5000
```

kevin_salesops: ✅ please add a dashboard tile for `fallback_30m_test` volume and a filter for `enrich_skipped`. will notify SDR leads.

maria_marketing: i'll draft a one-liner for SDR Slack: "Temporary fallback enabled during peak to reduce assignment delays — you'll see `enrich_skipped` on some records."

sam_ops: rolling the change up in 5. will post deploy details.

leadbot: deploy started by sam_ops at 4991235100 :rocket:

olivia_engineer: deployed, warming workers. enabling fallback now.

maria_marketing: monitoring — initial drop in >5m assigns from 12% -> 3% in first 3m. nice. :tada:

kevin_salesops: excellent. next steps: olivia to open an RFC for RR fairness + TTL-based graceful degrade, sam to add alert for enrichment-backlog > 500, maria to own comms with SDRs.

olivia_engineer: will do RFC today, include test permutations and perf numbers.

sam_ops: alert created: `enrichment.backlog.count > 500 for 5m` -> page on call-devs.

maria_marketing: thanks team. follow-ups in #marketing-ops sync tomorrow.
